name: leads_required_for_new_sales_hire
description: Monthly lead volume, wins and won value for the last four complete months, plus all-time conversion rate and average won value. Use for 'how many leads do we need to support a new hire', 'can we afford another salesperson', 'what is our lead to win rate', 'what is an average won deal worth', 'how many leads a month are we getting'. IMPORTANT: this gives the CRM inputs only. The full sum is (monthly rep cost + target contribution) divided by (won-per-lead x average won value x gross margin) — rep cost and gross margin are NOT in this database. Present the inputs, ask the rep for those two figures, and only then do the arithmetic. Never assume a salary or a margin.

params.name: month
params.description: Narrow to one month, e.g. '2026-08'. Omit to see every month shown.

params.name: min_leads
params.description: Only months with at least this many leads. Rarely needed.
